messages.subject: PDF generation in Rmarkdown + Shiny?
parts:
Hi all, I have a question about PDF conversion in Rmarkdown from Shiny. We use Rmarkdown to generate reports after running all the analysis in an Shiny app. Users can choose from either .doc or .PDF format for their reports. The .doc file works well, whereas creating the .PDF always gives an error 'Error : pandoc document conversion failed with error 43'.

We had tested on three different computers (all have LaTex and Pandoc installed), the exactly same error message showed up. I also attempted to fix this by following some online instructions (e.g., add \usepackage[utf8]{inputnc} to the preamble of the tufte-handout.tex file in the rmarkdown package). However, none of them worked. 

Can anyone help? Is this a generic error message or a specific one? Thank you so much for your insight.
